status: FROZEN before A3 was trained and before any forecast of it existed. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it. Amendments only before any result is seen.
title: A third draw of variant A: how far a single draw wanders, and whether pooling draws repeats its bonus
origin: A (seed 20260909) gave -0.00133 (-6.1 %) and A2 (seed 20261003, evaluation/a_replication_plan.json) -0.00055 (-2.6 %) in calibrated Brier at 20 mm against the control arm on the same seed. Pooled into eight-member ensembles (scripts/pool_seeds.py, exploratory), A + A2 gave -0.00181 (-8.4 %) against control2000 + F, more than either draw, while the same pooling moved the control arms by about -0.7 % and Pavo by about -1.4 %. One explanation is that the hard-threshold term fires on few states, so each draw learns a different part of heavy rain and draws complement each other. A third draw tests it.

models.tailA2000s3: bris/train/finetune_tail_a_seed3.yaml (finetune_tail_a with base seed 20261024) at step 2000: ~/bris-models/tailA2000s3/tailA2000s3-step002000_inference.ckpt
models.control2000: the control arm, seed 20260909, already forecast for the test year
models.control2000s2: F, the control arm on seed 20261003, already forecast for the test year

note_on_the_comparator: No control arm exists on seed 20261024. Seed alone moved the control arm by about 0.3 % (F against control2000), small against the effects here, so A3 is compared with the control arm on A's seed. It is the same comparator A was measured against, so the three single draws are on one footing.
test: exactly as evaluation/a_replication_plan.json: 2025-08-01..2026-09-06, 4 members, BRIS_LEADTIMES=7, +30 h, strict common cases of the models and MEPS, scripts/hits_and_calibration.py --cv month --replicates 5000 --meps. Forecasts may be split into date chunks; a final pass fills any day a job lost to the cluster.

primary_endpoint.measure: Brier score at 20 mm per day after month-out isotonic calibration, tailA2000s3 minus control2000, four members each
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: paired block bootstrap, seven-day blocks, 5000 replicates
primary_endpoint.positive_if: the upper 95 percent bound is below 0
primary_endpoint.negative_if: the lower 95 percent bound is above 0

registered_expectation: Exploratory, with scripts/pool_seeds.py extended to the third draw: the eight-member pools A + A3 and A2 + A3 each beat control2000 + F (eight members) in calibrated Brier at 20 mm by more than the better of their two single draws does against its own control arm. Reported whichever way it goes.
secondary_reported: tailA2000s3 minus control2000s2 (F), calibrated and raw, at 20 mm
raw Brier at 20 mm against control2000, with its sign and a paired block bootstrap
the same at 10 and 50 mm; ROC area; frequency bias
mean precipitation over all station-days relative to observed (scripts/precip_overall.py)
2 m temperature and 10 m wind against Frost with scripts/general_skill.py, against control2000 (exploratory)
the spread of the three single-draw results, as the plain measure of how much one draw of A wanders
not_claimed: Three draws of one recipe at step 2000 on one test year. A pooled ensemble is two or three models run side by side, not one better model, and doubles or triples the forecast cost.
